statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-45822 (GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr): when decodeURIComponent throws on malformed percent-encoded input, decode-uri-component through 0.4.2 falls back to a decoder that re-splits and retries the input recursively, so crafted input can make decoding take exponential time and exhaust CPU. It is fixed in 0.5.0 by commit fa479da, which replaces that fallback with a single-pass UTF-8 scanner: https://github.com/SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component/security/advisories/GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr, https://github.com/SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component/commit/fa479dafeede7bedf04e5c89aa78f2a78c664005, https://github.com/SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component/releases/tag/v0.5.0 . The only file in each jaeger-dev package is /usr/bin/jaeger, a Go program that embeds the prebuilt assets of the jaeger-ui release with the same version number as gzip-compressed files. We read every published jaeger-dev package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository: 21 builds, 2.19.0-r1 to the current 2.23.0-r4, each for x86_64 and aarch64, every download checked against its index checksum. In each build we decompressed every gzip stream in /usr/bin/jaeger and searched the JavaScript for the library's code. In 2.19.0-r1 to 2.20.0-r5 the bundle contains the vulnerable 0.4.x fallback: the regular expression (%[a-f0-9]{2})|([^%]+?) and the recursive decoder that uses it. In 2.21.0-r0 to 2.22.0-r3 it contains the 0.5.0 single-pass decoder (its /^[a-f\d]{2}$/i byte parser and UTF-8 sequence-length check) and not the 0.4.x expression. From 2.23.0-r0 it contains neither the library's percent-token expression nor its %FE%FF replacement map, so the library is no longer present. Every build of one Jaeger version carries an identical bundle, and a search of the uncompressed binary finds none of these strings, so there is no uncompressed copy. This matches the jaeger-ui lockfiles: v2.19.0 and v2.20.0 lock decode-uri-component 0.4.1, v2.21.0 and v2.22.0 lock 0.5.0, and v2.23.0 does not depend on it: https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/blob/v2.19.0/package-lock.json, https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/blob/v2.20.0/pnpm-lock.yaml, https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/blob/v2.21.0/pnpm-lock.yaml, https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/blob/v2.22.0/pnpm-lock.yaml, https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/blob/v2.23.0/pnpm-lock.yaml . 2.21.0-r0 is the first fixed build for this owner.
